raw_output_text: {"main_idea":"The text is an assignment brief for a long policy analysis on a hypothetical data sovereignty regulation. It asks for a detailed study of its rules, compliance challenges, national security benefits, and trade implications, using a case study of DataTech Solutions Inc. vs. National Data Protection Authority of Country X.","key_points":["The response must cover the regulation’s history, main rules, and key data categories with clear examples.","It must analyze conflicts with foreign laws, cross-border transfers, and strategies for multinationals.","It must evaluate the case study, including jurisdiction, technical changes needed, and the outcome for the company and regulator.","It must also offer balanced advice on future trade and security, including risk-based rules, interoperable frameworks, and privacy-enhancing technologies."]}

{"main_idea":"The text explains why strong promoter screening is important for metabolic engineering. It says a promoter library is needed to find promoters of the right strength for gene expression control.","key_points":["Microorganisms are used to make many chemicals and materials from fossil resources.","Precise gene expression control is needed for metabolic flux in synthetic and systems biotechnology.","Promoters are a major way to regulate gene expression at the transcription level.","A promoter library with many intensities is needed to screen for strong constitutive promoters in E. coli and S. marcescens."]}

{"main_idea":"This text studies how profitability, audit committee, company size, and board of directors affect a company’s sustainability. It finds that profitability, activity level, and the audit committee have significant effects, while board of directors does not.","key_points":["The study uses panel data from Jakarta Islamic Index companies from 2017 to 2021.","It uses Ordinary Least Square, Fixed Effects, Random Effects, and Robust regression methods.","Profitability Ratio has a negative effect on sustainability.","Activity Ratio does not have a positive effect on sustainability.","Company size has a positive effect on sustainability.","The audit committee has a negative effect on sustainability.","The board of directors does not have a positive effect on sustainability."]}

{"main_idea":"This text explains who needs a Schengen visa to enter Spain as a tourist and how to apply one. It also says what documents, fees, and rules you must follow.","key_points":["EU citizens, some US, Canada, and a few other citizens do not need a visa for up to 90 days.","Most people from South America, Asia, and Africa need a Schengen visa for Spain as a tourist.","The application form asks for personal details, travel plans, reason for visiting, and supporting documents.","You must submit required documents like itineraries, health insurance, income proof, and sometimes a letter from your employer or tax return.","The fee is 64 euros, and you can apply from the Spanish consulate or embassy where you are a legal resident, and it usually takes one or two weeks."]}

{"main_idea":"The text explains how the federal government uses NAICS and other business codes to classify and register contractors. It says you must register in SAM before you can accept any government contracts.","key_points":["NAICS is used to classify U.S. businesses for economic statistics and to classify federal contracts.","The latest NAICS manual is at https://www.census.gov/naics.","You may need a Federal Tax ID number, Sic codes, and other related codes for registration.","SAM is the main database for managing federal contracts, and you must register there before accepting any government work."]}

{"main_idea":"This text explains how to get a waiver after a U.S. immigrant visa denial. It says some people can apply, and some denial reasons do not qualify, so you must read the denial letter and follow the directions.","key_points":["You should read the denial letter to know why you were rejected and how to apply for a waiver.","A waiver may be available for health reasons, false claims about U.S. citizenship, fraud, misrepresentation, or unlawful presence.","If you lost the denial letter, contact the consulate where you had the interview, and an attorney may help you prepare and appeal.","If unlawful presence denied your visa, you may file Form I-601 before leaving the U.S. and pay the required fee."]}

{"main_idea":"This text explains how to register to vote by mail in California. It says you must meet eligibility rules and then sign and return the mailed form.","key_points":["You need the last 4 digits of your Social Security number or a California ID number to fill out the form.","The DMV uses your California ID signature to sign the voter registration card, but you may still register without one.","The online form is available in English and Spanish, and overseas voters and military personnel have a different process.","You must be 18, a California resident, mentally competent, a U.S. citizen, and not detained by the courts or on parole for a felony."]}

{"main_idea":"This text explains how to apply for a U.S. green card and what to do after approval. It also says that a visa must be available, and that the process includes forms, fees, fingerprints, medical tests, and card renewal.","key_points":["You must first check visa availability and then choose a green card category and the rules for that path.","You must file the correct forms and supporting documents with the required fee and photo in the right way.","Some applicants need fingerprints, an affidavit of support, a medical report, or an interview, and USCIS will provide instructions for these steps.","After approval and payment of the immigration fee, the green card is usually issued within 30 days, and permanent residents must renew it every 10 years."]}

{"main_idea":"This text explains how to apply to become a Wisconsin notary public. It says you must meet the rules, pass the exam, get approved, and renew your commission.","key_points":["You must show no disqualifying criminal history and you must get a criminal history check.","You must meet the eligibility rules, including age, education, residency, and U.S. citizenship.","You must complete the online tutorial, pass the exam within the past six months, and score at least 90.","You must file the application, bond, oath, and exam certificate with the state, and then renew every four years."]}

{"main_idea":"Oakland City Center is a large office, shopping, and hotel complex in downtown Oakland. Its history shows repeated plans, delays, and changes that shaped the site into what it is today.","key_points":["The complex sits on twelve city blocks between Broadway, Martin Luther King Jr. Way, Frank H. Ogawa Plaza, and 10th Street.","Its mall was built after wartime and urban renewal efforts removed older residential and commercial buildings by eminent domain.","The project faced strong opposition, delays, and a scaled-down plan after residents and groups objected to a larger vision.","Later phases added office buildings, condominiums, and a hotel, with ongoing work on two of the remaining vacant parcels."]}

{"main_idea":"The text explains the history of American Samoa and the broader history of Samoa. It shows how the islands were settled, colonized, and divided between the United States and independent Samoa.","key_points":["Samoa and its nearby islands were first settled thousands of years ago and were later linked by Polynesian trade and chiefdoms.","Western contact began in the 18th century, and Christianity was introduced in the 19th century through missionary work.","The Samoan archipelago was divided between the United States and Germany through the 1899 Berlin Treaty and later treaties.","American Samoa became a U.S. territory after the treaties were ratified in 1929, while Western Samoa became independent Samoa."]}
